releaseNotes:
💎 Lossless Audio: Studio master 24-bit and 16-bit CD-quality uncompressed audio engine.
🖼️ High-Res Artwork: Crisp high-definition cover art decoding with animated visualizers.
🎤 Synced Lyrics: Real-time, word-by-word animated lyrics synchronized with playback.
⚡ Enhanced Performance & Stability: Offline IndexedDB storage, native Android Capacitor support, and smooth background audio.
